architecture: hybrid: 10 hand-crafted quality axes concatenated with a frozen RETFound (ViT-L/16, retina-specific MAE) embedding, single calibrated logistic head
regularization: L2 logistic regression over [hand features || RETFound embedding]
threshold_calibration: Fit on the development cohort alone (five-fold out-of-fold predictions); applied unchanged to all five external validation cohorts.
intended_use: Backbone-ablation baseline for the manuscript's peer-review response: technical quality triage for standard and portable colour fundus photographs.
excluded_use: Ultrawide-field imaging and autonomous clinical decision making
predecessor: EyeQC-v3-hybrid-CFP-2026 (DINOv2 ViT-B/14 embedding instead of RETFound); this model exists solely to measure whether a retina-specific self-supervised backbone improves on the shipped general-purpose DINOv2 backbone under an otherwise identical protocol.
